envelope.text: ADOPT-BOUNDED: one process-wide record, where rcl keeps one per thread.

why: ADOPTED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 C5): rcl's `rcl_reset_error()` (a macro over `rcutils_reset_error` upstream): forget the recorded error. Ours-only to the correlator because upstream spells it as a `#define`. ENVELOPE (stated on the declaration): ONE process-wide record under a lock where rcl keeps one per thread, and 256-byte strings (rcutils: 1024); see `c:error_state_t`. Test: `packages/api/nros-c/tests/run/rcl_error_state.c`.
